Strategy: Give +30 to the second-loosest bin, keeping the loosest one in reserve while still placing loosely, with Best Fit ordering elsewhere.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mx = max(bins)
    second = max([x for x in bins if x < mx]) if len([x for x in bins if x < mx]) > 0 else mx
    return [-(r - item) + (30 if r == second else 0) for r in bins]
```
